text:
Anita: kicking off slate-7b int4 canary bring-up, hitting intermittent OOMs at decode with long generations. details in perf harness.
Ravi: can you share canary runtime config?
Anita: batch_window=25ms, max_batch=6, max_new_tokens=1200 (default), prefetch=2, slot_compact=baseline
Sofia: repro summary?
Anita: ran 2k warm requests, ~18% fail at token ~900. pattern: kv cache jump + allocator alignment failure. log:
```
[OOM] decode token=904
alloc_align(128MB) failed
kv_cache: 1.6GB -> 2.4GB
prefetch=2 -> added 2 slots per req
```
Theo: int4 kernels often create extra temp buffers for partial pack/unpack. fragmentation likely. any quality deltas vs fp16?
Anita: yes, our long-context QA suite shows -2.1% EM on >512 prompts. short prompts unaffected. hypothesis: prefetch alters input alignment -> slight logit shifts on quantized kernels
Ravi: prioritize stability. mitigation options?
Sofia: quick mitigations: A) lower default max_new_tokens to 512 for slate; B) reduce prefetch to 0/1; C) introduce prompt-length gating to scale max_new_tokens down for long prefixes
Anita: I patched canary: max_new_tokens=512, prefetch=1 on 12 nodes. early metric: OOM rate fell to 0.9%, 95p latency +8ms
Theo: good. But that could mask the real int4 numeric issue. plan to root-cause?
Anita: plan: 1) run microbench with prefetch=0 vs prefetch=2 capturing GPU alloc histogram and peak mem 2) spin a routing rule to soft-fallback to fp16 if kv_est > threshold 3) AB eval on long-context split int4 vs fp16 4) behind-flag kernel tweak (align KV buffers to 64B) smoke test
Ravi: how is kv_est computed?
Sofia: kv_est = (prompt_tokens + min(max_new_tokens, 600)) * kv_bytes_per_token_est (we use 24 bytes/token approx). we pre-flag heavy reqs and route to fp16 cluster.
Anita: implemented flagging in router; early results route ~6% of traffic and reduced OOM tail by ~85%
Theo: add runtime tracer to collect allocation sizes/frees over 24h. helps confirm fragmentation vs legitimate growth
Anita: tracer on 6 canary nodes for 24h, artifacts at s3://redwood-canary/slate/int4/frag-traces-3839991234
Ravi: AB details?
Sofia: splitting 50/50 on long-context eval. metrics: exact_match, tokenwise KL, and topk softmax displacement. threshold: EM delta >1.5% with p<0.05 triggers automatic rollback.
Anita: also opened ticket PLAT-1812 to change SDK default and add console toggle for model-level max_new_tokens so customers can override. assigned Ravi.
Theo: kernel work behind-flag only. Sofia, can you coordinate smoke runs and perf hysteresis checks?
Sofia: yes, I'll build int4 kernel variant with 64B pack, behind feature flag, smoke on 2 nodes.
infra-bot: noted: canary monitor enabled, alerting to #incidents if OOM rate >2%
Anita: summary ACTIONS:
- keep canary patched (max_new_tokens=512, prefetch=1) (Anita)
- router kv_est fallback to fp16 (Ravi)
- AB eval (Sofia)
- kernel-behind-flag smoke (Theo + Sofia)
- runtime allocation tracer (Theo)
- SDK/Console docs ticket PLAT-1812 (Ravi)
Sofia: timeline: AB completes ~6h, tracer 24h, kernel smoke tomorrow. will report back
Ravi: I'll prep release-war-room entry if we roll out
Anita: thanks team, will post results here
